projects.title: Biometric Wearable
projects.subtitle: PPG + IMU Athletic Wearable, ESP32 POC to 6-Layer nRF52840 EVT
projects.description: An athletic biometric wearable in two builds: an ESP32-S3 POC proving the sensing chain end to end, then a 6-layer nRF52840 EVT written in atopile - 0201, BGA, and DFN packaging, nPM1300 power, 50-board production run.
specs: Tech: nRF52840 (BC840), MAX30101 PPG, BMI270 IMU, nPM1300 PMIC, atopile + KiCad

projects.title: Haptica Capture Rig
projects.subtitle: Egocentric Multimodal Capture for Robot Learning
projects.description: Founder-built capture system recording synchronized vision, depth, tactile, and kinematic data from humans doing skilled manual work — the training data robots can't scrape.
specs: 4× global-shutter cameras on Jetson AGX Orin: stereo head pair + wrist cams, hardware frame sync, GPS-disciplined time
Custom FPCB tactile skin: piezoresistive matrix + custom acquisition electronics
Pipeline: synced session bundles → rosbag2/MCAP → LeRobot training packages over 10 GbE ingest
